decisions.reason: As a flagship, strategically central transactional email service built on the core platform, it remains worth keeping because its fit with the firm’s cloud messaging direction outweighs its likely low carrying cost.

Document capture supports the firm’s document workflow expansion, so management would keep it for now, though it is a more peripheral and potentially more resource-intensive option than the core messaging offers.
The email and fax conversion service still matches installed-base and regulated-process needs and is likely inexpensive to maintain, making it reasonable to keep despite weaker growth prospects.
Email sandbox threat protection directly strengthens the firm’s secure communications value proposition and cross-sell potential, so it remains a sensible option to retain.
